root_cause.text: The tile info buffer was allocated using the tile count (`AV1_MAX_TILES`) as the byte size instead of the actual byte requirement (`AV1_MAX_TILES * 16`), leading to a heap buffer overflow when writing tile info structures.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `dma_alloc_coherent(vpu->dev, AV1_MAX_TILES, ...)` to `dma_alloc_coherent(vpu->dev, AV1_TILE_INFO_SIZE, ...)` and also updates `av1_dec->tile_info.size = AV1_MAX_TILES` to `av1_dec->tile_info.size = AV1_TILE_INFO_SIZE`, confirming the original allocation was only 8192 bytes (if AV1_MAX_TILES = 8192) instead of the required 8192*16 bytes.
